_meta.notes: Master URL registry for longevity/aging domain. Heavy A-tier bias — many claims in this domain are mechanistic/early-stage so we anchor to peer-reviewed journals where possible.

sources.reliability_notes: Official 2009 Nobel in Physiology or Medicine — Blackburn, Greider, Szostak for telomere/telomerase
Official 2016 Nobel advanced scientific background — Ohsumi autophagy (relevant to autophagy-aging decline)
Harrison DE, Strong R, Sharp ZD et al. 2009 — Rapamycin fed late in life extends lifespan in genetically heterogeneous mice (NIA ITP landmark paper)
Horvath S 2013 — DNA methylation age of human tissues and cell types (Horvath clock original paper — 353 CpG sites)
López-Otín C, Blasco MA, Partridge L, Serrano M, Kroemer G. 'The Hallmarks of Aging' Cell 2013 — foundational framework cited >20,000 times
López-Otín C et al. 'Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe' Cell 2023 — updated 12 hallmarks
Yang JH et al. 'Loss of epigenetic information as a cause of mammalian aging' Cell 2023 — Sinclair lab evidence of epigenetic aging reversal via OSK factors
Lu Y, Brommer B, Tian X et al. (Sinclair lab) 2020 Nature — 'Reprogramming to recover youthful epigenetic information and restore vision' in aged mice
Massudi H et al. 2012 — Age-associated changes in oxidative stress and NAD+ metabolism in human tissue (NAD drops ~50% age 20→60)
Yousefzadeh MJ, Zhu Y et al. 2018 — 'Fisetin is a senotherapeutic that extends health and lifespan' in aged mice (~10% median lifespan extension)
Hickson LJ, Langhi Prata LGP et al. 2019 — 'Senolytics decrease senescent cells in humans' (D+Q open-label pilot in IPF patients)

sources.org: Journal of Gerontology Series A / Oxford Academic
sources.reliability_notes: Kumar P, Osahon OW, Sekhar RV et al. 2022 — 'Glycine and N-acetylcysteine (GlyNAC) supplementation improves aging hallmarks' in older adults RCT
Wei M, Brandhorst S, Longo VD et al. 2017 — 'Fasting-mimicking diet and markers/risk factors for aging, diabetes, cancer, and cardiovascular disease' (three 5-day cycles)
Waziry R, Ryan CP, Corcoran DL, Belsky DW et al. 2023 — 'Effect of long-term caloric restriction on DNA methylation measures of biological aging' (CALERIE-2 RCT, DunedinPACE slowed)
Yoshino M, Yoshino J, Klein S et al. 2021 — 'Nicotinamide mononucleotide increases muscle insulin sensitivity in prediabetic women' (N=25 RCT)

Andreux PA, Blanco-Bose W, Auwerx J et al. 2019 — 'The mitophagy activator urolithin A is safe and induces a molecular signature of improved mitochondrial and cellular health in humans' (first-in-human)

sources.org: American Journal of Clinical Nutrition / Oxford Academic
sources.reliability_notes: Kiechl S, Pechlaner R, Willeit P, Notdurfter M, Paulweber B et al. 2018 — 'Higher spermidine intake is linked to lower mortality' (prospective cohort N=829, 20-year follow-up)
Martens CR, Denman BA, Mazzo MR et al. 2018 — Chronic nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation raises NAD+ ~60% in middle-aged/older adults
Ocampo A, Reddy P, Izpisúa Belmonte JC et al. 2016 — 'In vivo amelioration of age-associated hallmarks by partial reprogramming' (OSKM pulsed in progeria mice)
Baker DJ, Childs BG, Durik M et al. 2016 — 'Naturally occurring p16Ink4a-positive cells shorten healthy lifespan' (INK-ATTAC senescent cell clearance extends healthspan ~25%)
Camacho-Pereira J, Tarragó MG, Chini EN et al. 2016 — 'CD38 dictates age-related NAD decline and mitochondrial dysfunction' (SIRT3 axis)
Epel ES, Blackburn EH, Lin J, Dhabhar FS, Adler NE, Morrow JD, Cawthon RM 2004 — 'Accelerated telomere shortening in response to life stress'
Hayflick L, Moorhead PS 1961 — 'The serial cultivation of human diploid cell strains' (Hayflick limit discovery)
Kanfi Y, Naiman S, Amir G, Peshti V, Zinman G, Nahum L, Bar-Joseph Z, Cohen HY 2012 — 'The sirtuin SIRT6 regulates lifespan in male mice' (transgenic overexpression extended lifespan)

Gomes AP, Price NL, Sinclair DA et al. 2013 — 'Declining NAD+ induces a pseudohypoxic state disrupting nuclear-mitochondrial communication during aging' (NMN restored muscle NAD and function in 22-month mice)
Buettner 'Power 9' — 5 Blue Zone regions (Okinawa, Sardinia, Nicoya, Ikaria, Loma Linda); lifestyle patterns in centenarian clusters. Popular-science framing — use with 'observational' caveat
Official NIA Interventions Testing Program — lists tested compounds and lifespan results across 3 independent mouse labs
VO2max and all-cause mortality association — Mandsager 2018 JAMA Netw Open reference data (low CRF = mortality risk comparable to CAD)
Mandsager K et al. 2018 — 'Association of Cardiorespiratory Fitness With Long-term Mortality' N=122,007 patients — elite fitness associated with 80% lower mortality vs low fitness
Haycock PC et al. 2014 BMJ meta-analysis — 'Leucocyte telomere length and risk of cardiovascular disease' (short LTL → 54% ↑ CAD risk)
Peter Attia podcast and content — Four Horsemen framework; Zone 2, VO2max, ApoB-centric thinking. Expert self-published content (use with evidence-tier caveat)
David Sinclair lab at Harvard — sirtuin, NAD, OSK reprogramming research
Valter Longo lab — FMD, ProLon, fasting biology
